parts.problem_md:
Desktop computers commonly use Hard Disc Drives (HDD) rather than Solid State Drives (SSD).

**Describe two** advantages of using an HDD rather than an SSD in a desktop computer.
parts.solution_md:
Two advantages of using an HDD rather than an SSD in a desktop are:

- Cheaper cost per Gb than SSD **[1 mark]**
- Longer lifespan with unlimited read/write cycles **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
A shopkeeper sells fruit and has created a table containing the name of the fruit, its bar code number and an image of the bar code.

Part of the table is shown.

![Table listing types of fruit with corresponding bar code numbers and images: Apple Fuji, Apple Jona Gold, and Apricot with numeric bar codes.](assets/001-table-listing-types-of-fruit-with-corresponding-.png)

**Describe **the advantages and disadvantages of entering the data by scanning the bar code rather than typing in the number.
parts.solution_md:
Examples of the advantages of entering data by scanning the bar code include:

Max **two **from the following:

- Faster data entry **[1 mark]**
- Fewer data entry errors are made **[1 mark]**

Examples of the disadvantages of entering data by scanning the bar code include:

Max **two **from the following:

- The scanner could misread the barcode whereas people typing in the data are more likely to check **[1 mark]**
- Extra hardware is required increasing costs **[1 mark]**
- If the bar code is damaged/folded/missing then the data may not be read properly **[1 mark]**
- More reliant on the technology **[1 mark]**
- If the barcode is incorrect the scanner would not know whereas a human could see the difference **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
When a person changes their password they are asked to verify that it has been entered correctly by re-entering the password.

The keyboard used to enter the password is an input device.

**Explain **the differences between input and output devices.
parts.solution_md:
The difference between input and output devices include:

Any **four **of the following:

- An input device sends data to a computer for processing **[1 mark]**
- An output device receives data from the computer **[1 mark]**
- An output device displays the results of processed data **[1 mark]**
- Input devices are controlled by the user **[1 mark]**
- Output devices are controlled by the computer **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Many laptop computers use the cloud to store data. A technician has produced a report on his laptop computer but has stored the report on a memory stick rather than storing it on the cloud.

**Describe two **advantages of using a memory stick rather than the cloud to store data.
parts.solution_md:
Advantages of using a memory stick rather than the cloud to store data include:

Any **two** of the following:

- Does not need access to the internet **[1 mark]**
- Fewer issues storing the data as the connection could drop during storage if the cloud is used **[1 mark]**
- More control over the stored data **[1 mark]**

parts.problem_md:
Portable hard drives can be Solid State Drives (SSDs) or Hard Disk Drives (HDDs).

**Explain **why the SSD may be better to use than the HDD.
parts.solution_md:
Reasons why the SSD may be better to use than the HDD include:

Any **four **of the following:

- The SSD is more portable **[1 mark]**
- The seek time in the SSD is smaller **[1 mark]**
- The data transfer rate in the SSD is better/smaller **[1 mark]**
- There is less chance of the data becoming corrupted as it can save whilst the drive is being moved **[1 mark]**
- The SSD is smaller/thinner **[1 mark]**
- The SSD uses less energy SSD is more robust as no moving parts **[1 mark]**
